notes: Species photos are representative; only the harbor seal was photographed in New Jersey. Never label other photos as Jersey City sightings.
These historical and modern park images show different viewpoints; label dates and avoid implying an aligned same-place restoration comparison.

Hudson River water nymph is Najas muenscheri, treated in Flora of North America as Najas guadalupensis subsp. muenscheri; not Vallisneria. No verified openly licensed photo found for this exact taxon. Do not substitute a different aquatic plant.
